item.title: Alabama Prison Documentary ‘The Alabama Solution’ Earns Oscar Nomination
item.description: THE BIRMINGHAM TIMES — “If they come down here to Birmingham and they want to be a police officer, the first thing they probably do will take a mental evaluation test. Well, if that officer wants to be an officer, if he fails that test, guess where the next place he goes to get a job. It’s with the Alabama Department of Corrections,” said Former corrections officer Stacy George.
